get_desc:
My ears told me that going left today would bring good luck — and they were right!
I spotted a massive stretch of red mountains, and from above, they looked like...
Giant crimson clouds drifting through the Starsea. Gorgeous and majestic.
I wrote down the coordinates. Let's go see it together next time!

Today's route was a real treat for the eyes! I passed by several bamboo Islets.\nWhen we get the chance, let's grab some bamboo logs and make a Hexia-style rainstick.\nMy ears guarantee it'll sound amazing!

Truth be told, my ears decided the route this time around!\nExperience has taught me that following interesting sounds can never wrong!\nAnd just as I thought — a wonderful find this time, too. An oasis in the middle of a desert planet.

The route this time was a real challenge — trekking through a rainforest!\nThe good news is I've accomplished the mission! Not without catching a cold, however...\nThankfully it can't be transmitted through PuffPost.

And lastly, I have to say, this expedition was super... eco-friendly.
Ahem, what I mean is, even though I didn't bring back much...
I did scatter some seeds I had on the Islets I passed by. That way, when I return later...
There'll be more to find and bring back, kula bata!
But I had a few bumps along the way this time, so there's not much of a haul.\nI'll try switching routes next time...\nThere are still so many secrets in the Starsea waiting for us. Kula bata!
Oh, right! I brought back quite the haul today.\nHope you like what I found. Kula bata!

Unfortunately, the Starsea tides started coming in on my way back...\nBut thankfully, I had your supplies, so everything turned out okay.\nSo, what did we gain from this expedition? Some experience dealing with bad weather. Kula bata!
And finally, I've attached the finds to this PuffPost.\nIt's not much, but...\nI hope it makes you happy. Kula bata!
Speaking of which, I was pretty lucky with the expedition today! Found a haul of good stuff.\nI bet it's because of that passing tumbleweed!\nHow about we go chase them together next time? Kula bata!
